title: Bounding
summary: Exaggerated running strides for distance, for sprint and leg power rather than size.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.55 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.55 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.5 for calves (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly calves total.
Library rating 0.45 for quads (helper): each working set adds 0.45 of a set to the weekly quads total.

setup.text: Run in long, springy strides, driving your knee up.
Push off hard and stay in the air on each stride.
Land on the ball of your foot and repeat.

form_cues.cue: Do these on grass or a track, and stop when your form slips.

mistakes.text: Taking short steps instead of long bounds.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
